question.problem: In Oslo, Norway, the average temperature in November is ${3.3}^{∘}\,\text{C}.$ In January, the average temperature decreases by ${6.2}^{∘}\,\text{C}$ compared to November. Finally, in March, the average temperature increases by ${4.6}^{∘}\,\text{C}$ compared to January. Determine the average temperature in Oslo in March.
question.worked_solution:
First, we must determine the average temperature in Oslo during the month of January. Since we know that the temperature decreases on average by ${6.2}^{∘}\,\text{C}$ compared to November, we subtract the variation in temperature from the average temperature in November. This gives

$$
{3.3}^{∘}\,\text{C}-{6.2}^{∘}\,\text{C}=-{2.9}^{∘}\,\text{C}.
$$

Now, we must determine the temperature during the month of March. Since we know that the temperature increases on average by ${4.6}^{∘}\,\text{C}$ compared to January, we add the variation in temperature to the average temperature in January. This gives

$$
-{2.9}^{∘}\,\text{C}+{4.6}^{∘}\,\text{C}={1.7}^{∘}\,\text{C}.
$$

Therefore, the average temperature in Oslo in March is ${1.7}^{∘}\,\text{C}.$
